# S358 — Local roles: start a fresh session instead of compacting

*Proposed.* Owner decision 2026-11-12 (relay session 8d711f67, chat: "2 is a great idea. file it"): a local role never reaches auto-compaction. When its context passes a threshold, ork ends the session and starts a new one with the same brief plus the role's own progress so far. A fresh start costs seconds; a compaction on the local server costs 15-19 minutes. Cloud roles do not change.

**Findings:** S304 trial 2 (2026-11-12, S314): claude-local auto-compacted three times at about 83-86k tokens, taking 893 s, 983 s and 1121 s (50 of 90 min), and after the first compaction it lost its brief and went looking for it in its own transcript. · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**2026-11-12** — [decision] 2026-11-12, owner in interactive question (session 8d711f67): Q1 70k tokens (adj 335), Q2 scratch-note in .scratch/progress-RUN-ROLE.md (adj 336).

## Why

*Proposed.* The local server spends 15-19 minutes per compaction because the model summarises the whole 85k-token context (trial 2 transcript `~/.claude/projects/-home-jon-code-squalor-xyz-ork--worktrees-S314/06e09bef-cc2f-4722-b1a3-4866518a6e48.jsonl`, `compact_boundary` entries). The work itself is not lost when a session ends: the edits are in the worktree. What a new session needs is the brief, the diff so far, and the role's short plan. claude CLI 2.1.322 has `--autocompact <auto|tokens>` with a 100k minimum, so compaction cannot be turned off below the launcher's window; ork must end the session first. ork already reads the claude stream (`internal/agent/claude/stream.go:152`); each assistant event carries the turn's input token count.

Open owner questions (the implementer asks them with `adj ask` first):

- Q1 (`roles.local-fresh-threshold`): at what context size does ork end the session? (a) *recommended*: 70k tokens, below the 83-86k where trial 2 compacted; (b) 60k; (c) a project setting with 70k as default.
- Q2 (`roles.local-progress-file`): where does the role keep its progress? (a) *recommended*: the role writes a short progress note (done, next, open problems) to `.scratch/progress-RUN-ROLE.md` in the main checkout after each step, and the new session's brief carries it with `git diff --stat` of the worktree; (b) no file: the new brief carries only `git diff --stat` and the diff of the changed files.
